messages:
maya: opened a draft to consolidate the quickstart into a slim, single-file 'pilot' example covering tokenless local dev, env var fallback, and a tiny Docker run for Dedicated customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3642
liam: neat. question: do we retire the multi-file tutorial or keep it as an advanced reference?
tara: keep the full repo as a "learn more" link. the main quickstart should be bite-sized for first-timers.
jordan: can we include a minimal SDK init snippet that shows env fallback? e.g.
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || undefined });
const out = await client.text.generate({ model: 'rwd-3b', input: 'Hi' });
console.log(out.output?.[0]?.text || 'no output');
```
maya: yes, that's in the draft. also added a one-liner for Dedicated KMS secrets + a container healthcheck example.
liam: CI flagged fence language inconsistencies (js vs javascript). standardized to "js" across the doc.
maya: thanks — fixed linting and pushed. pinging @docs-review for a quick accessibility and copy pass.
docs-bot: CI: docs build queued \u2699\ufe0f — preview URL will be posted once ready.
sarah: small improvement: under "auth setup" add a compact troubleshooting table (common env var mistakes + verification commands). i'll push a micro-commit.
tara: good call. also add a short note in runtime tips about default seq_len and when to pick quantized local images for faster dev loops.
jordan: adding a two-sentence quantization note (speed vs fidelity) and suggesting rwd-3b-quant for quick smoke tests.
maya: follow-ups: @sarah add troubleshooting table, @jordan add quantization note, @liam run linkcheck on SDK changelog and examples. after those commits i'll request final review.
liam: will run linkcheck and scan example URLs tonight.
sarah: pushed the troubleshooting table and linked the healthcheck example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/hello-healthcheck. also a tiny FAQ item about expired tokens.
maya: PR updated, running a local build. if preview is green we'll merge and backport to 2.1-stable and tag rc.
pr-bot: PR #3642 requested reviewers: liam, jordan, sarah
liam: approved on GH. :thumbsup: 
jordan: reviewed, made two micro-edits to the runtime language and pushed.
sarah: one copy tweak committed to the troubleshooting table.
ci-bot: preview build passed \u2705 — https://deploy-preview-3642--docs.redwood.ai
maya: merging after the final canary smoke pass. thanks all :rocket:
ci-bot: canary smoke checks passed. merged and backported to 2.1-stable.
